SELECT granted.menu_id FROM sys_menu a JOIN sys_menu p ON p.menu_id=a.parent_id AND p.status='0' JOIN sys_menu root ON root.menu_id=p.parent_id AND root.status='0' JOIN sys_menu granted ON granted.menu_id IN(a.menu_id,p.menu_id,root.menu_id) JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=#{actor} JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.role_id AND rm.menu_id=granted.menu_id WHERE a.menu_id=31082 AND p.menu_id=31080 AND root.menu_id=31000 AND a.perms='system.audit.read' AND a.status='0' AND ((#{actor}=1 AND r.role_id=1) OR rm.menu_id IS NOT NULL) FOR SHARE

SELECT m.menu_id FROM sys_menu m JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=#{actor} JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id AND r.status='0' AND r.del_flag='0' LEFT JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.role_id AND rm.menu_id=m.menu_id WHERE m.menu_id=31083 AND m.parent_id=31080 AND m.status='0' AND m.menu_type='C' AND ((#{actor}=1 AND r.role_id=1) OR rm.menu_id IS NOT NULL) FOR SHARE
